ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which organism in the diagram is an herbivore?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the image is a marine food web, with “phytoplankton” (phytoplankton) labeled on the lower left, and “Krill” (krill) labeled near it. In the image there is a food relationship arrow connecting phytoplankton and krill, indicating that krill feed on phytoplankton. Then reason: Herbivores are animals that eat plants or plant-like producers. In this marine food web, phytoplankton are producers, so krill that eat phytoplankton are herbivores.
